text:
Maria: T-minus 2 hours for the EU midnight slice. Quick preflight — I want explicit confirmation on failover and rollback playbooks.
Alex: +1. I pushed the release notes here: https://confluence/redwood/releases/3.4.1 — please skim the 'known-issues' section.
Lee: Oncall is staffed. I validated the runbook and global rollback owners list. I can trigger a fast-unpin if we see embedding latency > 300ms sustained.
Sam: Heads up: DeployBot will pin v3.4.1-canary to the eu pool at t-45m. If canary error rate > 2% for 5m we auto-unpin and fallback to v3.4.0.
DeployBot: [automated] Schedule: pin v3.4.1-canary to pool eu-primary at 23:15 UTC. Health checks: smoke, latency, 5xx-rate.
Jordan: Added a mini smoke checklist to the playbook:
```
- /smoke run quick-start (3 checks)
- sample-traffic: 10 requests/s x 2min
- validate-kv-cache warmup
- embedding sanity: cosine similarity threshold
```
Maria: Also confirm DB migration is no-op — Alex?
Alex: Confirmed. Migration gate is feature-flagged; no schema change. We tested rollback path: `deploy rollback --to v3.4.0 --grace 60s`. It's in the ops-runbook.
Lee: Failover scenarios we rehearsed: region OOM -> router routes rest to eu-backup; if backup capacity < 60% we trigger global pin to v3.4.0 and open incident channel.
Sam: For decision authority: if latency or 5xx crosses thresholds, oncall (Lee) decides to unpin. If we see data-corruption risk, Maria makes the rollback call.
Jordan: I've posted an abbreviated release-summary to #status-updates for PMs and sent the release-notes link to support.
Maria: Final go/no-go checklist (quick):
- [x] Release notes published
- [x] Canary image built and checksum verified
- [x] Monitoring dashboards updated
- [x] Oncall & SRE on standby
- [x] Rollback command tested
- [ ] Stakeholder ping at t-30m (I will send)
Alex: I'll pin the canary image sha to the deploy manifest now: `image: redwood/inference:v3.4.1-canary@sha256:abcd...`
DeployBot: [automated] Pin applied to manifest. Canary SHA: abcd1234.
Lee: I ran a dry-run unpin flow in staging earlier. Command sequence for ops: `deploy unpin --pool eu-primary && deploy pin --version v3.4.0` — should complete within 90s for small pools.
Sam: Note: If we need to roll back during the freeze period, file a freeze-exemption with reason "emergency rollback" so release processes keep trace.
Maria: t-30m: I'll post the stakeholder ping and switch this thread to 'release live' when we start the canary. Until then, thumbs up if you are ready.
Alex: 👍 ready.
Lee: 👍 oncall ready.
Sam: ✅ SRE ready and watching metrics.
Jordan: Support looped in. I'll be monitoring EOS slack and triage queue.
Maria: OK — proceeding to t-45m canary pin. DeployBot will post status. If anyone spots something odd DM me immediately. :pray:
